_comment: Clip upscaling and restoration on the user's ComfyUI with SeedVR2 7B, ComfyUI's native nodes (0.38+), as Comfy-Org's video template does it (utility_seedvr2_3b_int8_upscale_video, with the 7B): the clip's frames are resized by the factor with Lanczos, encoded with the tiled VAE (512 px tiles, 128 overlap; 64 frames at a time, 8 shared), split into temporal chunks sized to the free VRAM (2 latent frames shared and crossfaded; unload_first asks an idle ComfyUI to unload its models before the job, since the chunking measures the card before SeedVR2 loads and a SeedVR2 left resident by the last job dropped it to one frame a chunk), restored in one euler step each, merged, decoded tiled and colour-matched to the resized frames in CIELAB; the clip keeps its frame rate and its audio. The factor is extra.scale, a whole number (2 to 4, default 2: H.264 wants even frame sizes), lowered so a frame stays within upscale.max_megapixels and the whole clip within upscale.max_megapixel_frames: ComfyUI holds every frame several times over in memory (about 66 bytes a pixel-frame on the lab), and 317 megapixel-frames (a 113-frame 1280x548 loop at 2x) ran its 40 GiB out (2026-10-09). 120 keeps a job under about 8 GiB of the server's memory: a 5 s, 24 fps loop up to about 1 MP a frame after upscaling. A longer or larger clip is refused with what to do (trim or split it). Weights as seedvr2-7b.

_meta.vram_note: as seedvr2-7b (the same model; the temporal chunks are sized to the VRAM that's free), measured on the 5090 2026-10-09
_meta.seconds_note: a 5 s, 200x298 loop (120 frames) to 400x596 on the 5090; 116 s to 800x1192 (4x, 114 megapixel-frames, 8.0 GiB of the server's memory)
